edition.title: Imagination Atlas
edition.thesis: A field guide to ideas that survive the shrink.

admitted.title: Keepsake Knot
admitted.user_job: keep a small shared ritual tangible over time
admitted.signature: two unequal bands share one offset opening

admitted.title: Catnap Focus
admitted.user_job: enter a calm focus or rest interval without visual pressure
admitted.signature: the curled tail leaves one broad time wedge beside the sleeping face

admitted.title: Trail Tail
admitted.user_job: recognize and return to a favorite walking route
admitted.signature: one dog contour becomes the route and carries an off-axis clasp

admitted.title: Koi Return
admitted.user_job: recognize the next small return in a repeating practice
admitted.signature: a side-view koi swims into one edge-open upstream cut

admitted.title: Quiet Hero
admitted.user_job: recognize a poised original persona at a glance
admitted.cliche: generic chibi, animal ears, franchise imitation
admitted.signature: an asymmetric profile crest meets one high collar notch

admitted.title: Sky Courier
admitted.user_job: anticipate the next chapter without spoilers
admitted.signature: the satchel flap becomes a swept wing with one broad edge-open dry cut

admitted.title: Co-op Lock
admitted.user_job: coordinate lobby readiness without scanning avatars or check marks
admitted.cliche: controller, check mark, two avatars, chain links
admitted.signature: two unequal translucent keycaps lock around one shared opaque counter

admitted.title: Forest Familiar
admitted.user_job: guide a small companion home along a remembered trail
admitted.cliche: generic animal head, fox repeat, tree badge, map pin
admitted.signature: unequal ear tufts and two broad edge-open wing gouges define a full-body owl

admitted.title: Boss Helm
admitted.user_job: recognize and remember a conquered encounter
admitted.signature: one horn is structurally broken and exposes an ember fracture

field_briefs.title: Menders' Queue
field_briefs.user_job: route a damaged object to the next person who can repair it
field_briefs.signature: one wedge gouge is repaired by the cap's unbroken outer arc
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if texture is needed to distinguish the tool from a food mushroom.

field_briefs.title: Roost Ledger
field_briefs.user_job: check whether a shared bat roost needs care
field_briefs.cliche: bat silhouette, moon, sonar rings, map pin
field_briefs.signature: one wing-scalloped entrance cuts into the box's lower edge
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if the two-pixel entrance closes or the box reads as an inbox.

field_briefs.title: Brew Breath
field_briefs.user_job: know whether a ferment is active without opening the vessel
field_briefs.signature: one chamber widens around a single nested gas pocket
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if an opaque one-color skeleton cannot name the airlock.

field_briefs.title: Quiet Bridge
field_briefs.user_job: notice when an instrument needs a humidity adjustment
field_briefs.signature: one broad humidity channel opens between the bridge feet
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if the silhouette reads as a moustache, chair, or colonnade.

field_briefs.title: Split Pace
field_briefs.user_job: tell whether the current segment is ahead or behind pace
field_briefs.signature: one flap caught half-open changes the counter's outer edge
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if recognition needs a digit or the lifted flap is under two pixels.

field_briefs.title: Chapter Lantern
field_briefs.user_job: resume an episodic story at the exact active thread
field_briefs.cliche: star, wand, play button, franchise silhouette
field_briefs.signature: one page-corner notch changes the lantern's lower contour
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if the notch becomes decoration or the lantern loses its noun in silhouette.

field_briefs.title: Threshold Route
field_briefs.user_job: plan a step-free entrance sequence before arrival
field_briefs.cliche: wheelchair badge, map pin, check mark, doorway arrow
field_briefs.signature: one hinge gap remains open while the ramp changes level
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if the ramp becomes stairs or requires an accessibility badge.

field_briefs.title: Sample Carousel
field_briefs.user_job: preserve specimen provenance from collection to analysis
field_briefs.signature: an opaque provenance spine keys three unequal sample panes
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if transparency or tiny labels carry sample identity.

field_briefs.title: Tempo Wedge
field_briefs.user_job: align a count-in and transition tempo
field_briefs.signature: an edge-open pendulum cut crosses one tapered metronome mass
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if the cut closes at 16px or the mass becomes a generic triangle.

field_briefs.title: Loadout Pauldron
field_briefs.cliche: controller, robot head, crossed weapons, gear
field_briefs.signature: one structurally empty hardpoint bites into the shoulder contour
field_briefs.kill_condition: Reject if reflection bands, not the empty hardpoint, explain the equipment state.
